title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
body:
Last updated: 13 November 2026

FREE SHIPPING: All prepaid and Cash on Delivery orders have a delivery charge of ₹0, regardless of product value.

1. Free shipping across India

We do not add any delivery or shipping fee to orders for serviceable Indian addresses. Your order total equals your product subtotal.

2. Prepaid payment

Prepaid customers pay their complete product subtotal online. Nothing else is payable on delivery.

3. Cash on Delivery (COD) advance

COD customers pay an online confirmation advance based on the complete order's product subtotal (after product discounts):

  • Product subtotal below ₹700: ₹199 advance, capped at the product subtotal for very small orders.
  • Subtotal ₹700 or above (including exactly ₹700): ₹299 advance.

This is not an extra charge. The advance is deducted from the product subtotal to calculate the remaining cash/UPI balance on delivery. Examples: ₹500 product order = ₹199 online + ₹301 on delivery; ₹1,000 product order = ₹299 online + ₹701 on delivery. Shipping remains FREE for both.

4. Delivery time

We aim to deliver within 15 calendar days of purchase, subject to serviceability and logistics. Contact support@attiremart.shop for delayed shipments.

5. Cancellation and returns

Eligible cancellation requests can be made within 24 hours of purchase, and returns within 7 calendar days of delivery. Eligible online payments, including the COD advance, are refundable according to our Refund & Return Policy. Report defective or incorrect goods within 7 days.

6. Contact

ATTIRE MART · Manish Kumar Sonkar · S-10/290 A-1, Panchkosi Road, Purani Chungi, Shivpur, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, 221003, India.

title: Terms of Service
body:
Last updated: 13 November 2026

These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of the ATTIRE MART online store (ATTIRE MART) and all purchases of clothing, accessories, and products offered by ATTIRE MART. By accessing the site, saving items, or placing an order, you agree to be bound by these Terms, our Privacy Policy, Shipping & Delivery Policy, and Return, Refund & Cancellation Policy.

1. Operator and business identity

ATTIRE MART is an Indian e-commerce enterprise owned and operated by sole proprietor Manish Kumar Sonkar, having its principal place of business at:

S-10/290 A-1, Panchkosi Road, Purani Chungi, Shivpur, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, 221003, India.

Contact Email: support@attiremart.shop
Grievance Officer: Manish Kumar Sonkar (grievance@attiremart.shop)
Fraud Escalation: help.fraud@attiremart.shop

2. Product listings, descriptions and pricing

All prices on ATTIRE MART are stated in Indian Rupees (INR) and are inclusive of all applicable goods and services taxes (GST). We strive to display accurate product descriptions, specifications, colors, and sizing charts. Due to differences in monitor displays, lighting, and manufacturing variations, slight color variations may occur. Styling props shown in photographs are not included with the product.

3. Free shipping

ATTIRE MART provides free delivery (₹0 shipping charge) on every prepaid and COD order to serviceable Indian addresses.

4. Checkout and COD advances

Prepaid orders require online payment of the full product total. COD orders require an online advance of ₹199 for subtotals below ₹700, or ₹299 for subtotals at ₹700 or above. Advances are capped at the product total and count toward the purchase price; the remaining balance is paid on delivery. No additional COD or delivery fee is charged.

5. Order acceptance and confirmation

Placing an item in your bag or wishlist does not reserve stock or constitute a placed order. An order is formally created and accepted only when:

  1. You submit your valid contact and delivery details at checkout;
  2. You accept these Terms and store policies; and
  3. The required online payment (full product total for prepaid, or the applicable COD advance) is successfully authorized and verified by the payment provider shown at checkout.

A unique order reference (e.g. AM...) is created during checkout and its payment status can be checked using that reference. An order is confirmed after the required payment has been independently verified. Email notifications may be sent when that service is enabled.

6. Fulfillment and delivery commitment

ATTIRE MART undertakes to deliver accepted orders within a maximum of 15 calendar days from the date of purchase, inclusive of processing, dispatch, and carrier transit. If delivery cannot be completed within 15 calendar days due to exceptional circumstances, you are entitled to request an update, expedited fulfillment, or a full refund.

7. Cancellations

You may cancel an order within 24 hours of purchase by emailing support@attiremart.shop with your order reference. If you cancel within this 24-hour window, or if ATTIRE MART cancels the order due to inventory unavailability, 100% of the amount paid online (including any COD confirmation advance) will be refunded to your original payment method through the original payment service provider.

8. Returns, replacements and refunds

Customers may request a return or size exchange within 7 calendar days of delivery for items that are unused, unwashed, unworn, and unaltered, with all original tags and packaging intact. For defective, damaged, or incorrect items, we provide a full refund or free replacement without charging return shipping fees. Refer to our Return, Refund & Cancellation Policy for complete procedures.

9. Payment security and data handling

All online payments are processed through the secure payment service provider displayed during checkout. ATTIRE MART never collects, views, or stores your complete card numbers, CVVs, expiry dates, net banking passwords, or UPI PINs. We store only masked transaction references, payment status, and reconciled amounts necessary for fulfillment and accounting.

10. User conduct and fraud prevention

Users must provide accurate, truthful name, mobile number, and delivery address details. Fraudulent orders, chargeback abuse, systematic refusal of COD deliveries after paying the advance, or automated scraping of website resources are strictly prohibited. We reserve the right to cancel suspicious orders, block abusive devices or transactions, and report financial fraud to competent law enforcement authorities.

11. Intellectual property

All text, images, logos, product photographs, styling designs, and graphics on this website are the property of ATTIRE MART or licensed for our use. Unauthorized copying, commercial reproduction, or hotlinking of assets without express written consent is prohibited.

12. Consumer grievance redressal

In compliance with the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, ATTIRE MART provides a dedicated grievance redressal mechanism:

  • Customer Support: support@attiremart.shop (Resolution target: 3–5 calendar days).
  • Grievance Officer: Manish Kumar Sonkar (grievance@attiremart.shop). Formal consumer grievances are acknowledged within 48 hours and redressed within one month from receipt.
  • Fraud Reporting: help.fraud@attiremart.shop.

13. Limitation of liability, fraud prevention and payment disputes

ATTIRE MART is the seller and operator of this online store, not a marketplace acting on behalf of unrelated sellers. We are responsible for the products we sell, the orders we accept, and the customer remedies required by our published policies and applicable Indian law. The provisions below clarify the reasonable limits of those responsibilities; they do not cancel genuine consumer rights.

13.1 Our responsibility for accepted orders

We take reasonable care with product descriptions, pricing, payment confirmation, packing, dispatch, delivery support, cancellations and eligible refunds. Once an order is accepted following verified payment, we remain responsible for resolving problems caused by incorrect, missing, damaged or defective goods, failed fulfilment, or mistakes within our control, as required by law and our Return, Refund & Cancellation Policy.

13.2 Payment service providers, banks and unauthorised transactions

Payments are processed by an independent regulated payment service provider and the relevant banks or payment networks. We do not obtain your UPI PIN, card CVV, online banking password or one-time password. We cannot control a bank's authorisation, a payment-network outage, a third party's impersonation of our business, or misuse of a payment instrument outside our systems. If you notice an unauthorised debit, phishing attempt or suspected account compromise, notify your bank or UPI provider promptly and email help.fraud@attiremart.shop with the relevant transaction reference. We will make reasonable checks of our order and payment records and cooperate with the provider and lawful investigations. We do not promise automatic reimbursement for losses caused solely by unrelated third parties; this does not exclude liability for our own proven breach, negligence, fraud or any legally mandatory remedy.

13.3 Chargebacks, payment reversals and friendly fraud

We respect a customer's right to raise a genuine dispute with the card issuer, bank, PayU or a competent authority. Knowingly making a false non-delivery claim after confirmed delivery, falsely denying an authorised transaction, initiating an unjustified duplicate refund, or misrepresenting a legitimate purchase may amount to abusive conduct. We may respond to a disputed payment with relevant, lawfully retained evidence, including the order reference, payment confirmation, delivery tracking, proof of delivery, support correspondence and applicable return/refund records. The issuing bank, payment provider or relevant authority decides the payment dispute under its rules; ATTIRE MART cannot guarantee that any dispute will be decided in a particular way. We may dispute claims we reasonably believe to be inaccurate, but we will not obstruct a legitimate chargeback, statutory complaint or refund.

13.4 False returns, item substitution and tampering

A customer must return the actual item received under the relevant order, with the condition and included components required by our Returns Policy, unless the item was damaged, defective or incorrectly supplied. Returning a counterfeit, substituted, unrelated, worn, intentionally damaged or materially altered item while claiming it is the original item is prohibited. We may inspect returned parcels, reconcile item identifiers and order records, and seek reasonable supporting evidence if an inconsistency is discovered. Where evidence establishes a fraudulent or ineligible return, we may decline a discretionary refund, request clarification, preserve relevant records or report suspected fraud through lawful channels. We will not automatically reject every return merely because an unboxing video was not supplied, and genuine defects, incorrect goods and mandatory consumer remedies remain protected.

13.5 Verification, investigation and cooperation

To review an order dispute, we may request the order number, a description of the issue, clear photographs where relevant, a payment reference or a return tracking number. We may consult courier or payment-provider records and allow reasonable time for an investigation. Personal information is handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy. An investigation does not remove a customer's right to raise an urgent bank dispute or escalate a formal consumer grievance, and we will not delay a refund unreasonably where one is legally due.

13.6 Chargeback fees and recovery of proven fraud

We do not impose an automatic penalty merely because a customer raises a chargeback or complaint in good faith. If clear evidence shows intentional fraud, we reserve the right to pursue recovery of proven losses or other appropriate relief only through lawful processes, subject to applicable law and payment-network rules. We may refuse future suspicious orders after a fair review, without restricting existing statutory rights.

13.7 Website and external service availability

We work to keep the website accessible, but cannot guarantee uninterrupted availability of telecommunications networks, payment gateways, hosting infrastructure, third-party couriers or other external services. Interruptions outside our reasonable control may affect ordering or delivery estimates. We will continue to provide applicable order, refund and grievance remedies for accepted purchases and communicate material fulfilment issues where reasonably possible.

13.8 Exclusion of indirect losses

To the extent permitted by law, we are not responsible for remote, unforeseeable or indirect commercial losses, such as lost profits, business opportunity or unrelated business interruption, resulting from ordinary website use or an order. This does not exclude a direct, foreseeable loss for which we are legally responsible or any protection that cannot lawfully be limited.

13.9 Limit on direct contractual liability

Subject to the exceptions below and to all mandatory legal obligations, our aggregate contractual liability for a claim directly arising from a particular order will ordinarily not exceed the amount actually paid for that affected order. This is not a deduction from an eligible refund, replacement, return shipping obligation or other remedy due under our policies or applicable law. It does not prevent compensation or other relief that a court or competent authority is empowered to order.

13.10 Mandatory consumer rights and exceptions

Nothing here excludes or limits liability for our fraud, wilful misconduct, fraudulent misrepresentation, personal injury caused by negligence, our own legally actionable data or payment-security failures, or any liability that cannot lawfully be restricted. These terms do not override the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, mandatory payment-network rules, or any right to approach a bank, regulator, consumer commission or court. If any part is unenforceable, the remaining lawful parts continue to apply. For assistance contact support@attiremart.shop; for formal grievances contact grievance@attiremart.shop.

14. Governing law and jurisdiction

These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of India. Any disputes arising out of or in connection with these Terms or website transactions shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India, without prejudice to statutory remedies available under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

title: Privacy Policy
body:
Last updated: 13 November 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how ATTIRE MART ("we", "us", "our") collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal information when you visit ATTIRE MART online store, place a guest order, purchase products, or communicate with our support team. We respect your privacy and are committed to safeguarding personal data in accordance with the Information Technology Act, 2000, and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

1. Personal information we collect

We collect only the personal information reasonably necessary to operate our store, process orders, deliver parcels, and provide customer assistance. This includes:

  • Identity & Contact Details: Full name, email address, and 10-digit Indian mobile number.
  • Delivery Address: Street address, flat/house number, landmark, city, state, postal PIN code, and country (India).
  • Guest Checkout & Device Preferences: No registration or password is required. If you choose to remember your address, delivery details are stored in your browser's local storage for convenience. Your bag, wishlist and order reference list may also be saved on this device.
  • Order & Purchase History: Purchased product items, size/color variant selections, quantities, order timestamps, and fulfillment milestones stored securely in our order database.
  • Payment Records: Payment transaction references, paid amount, and verification status. We NEVER collect, process, or store full credit/debit card numbers, CVVs, card expiry dates, bank passwords, OTPs, or UPI PINs. All payment credentials are keyed directly into PayU's hosted checkout.
  • Device & Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system, and request timestamps processed by our website infrastructure providers for security, fraud prevention, service reliability and protection against abusive traffic.
  • Browser Storage & Cookies: We use browser storage to remember your shopping bag, wishlist, optional delivery preferences and guest order references. We do not load third-party advertising tracking cookies or sell your personal data.
  • Communications: Records of your correspondence when you contact support, submit a return request, or contact our Grievance Officer.

2. How we collect your information

Your information is collected directly from you when you:

  • Browse products, add items to your bag, or save favorites to your wishlist;
  • Fill out the delivery form during checkout;
  • Complete an online payment through PayU; or
  • Contact us by email regarding support, returns, or formal grievances.

3. Purpose of data processing

We process your personal information strictly for legitimate e-commerce purposes:

  • Fulfilling and delivering your purchased items to your address;
  • Verifying and reconciling online payments with PayU;
  • Sending essential order and dispatch information when those notification services are enabled;
  • Handling cancellations, returns, replacements, and refunds;
  • Preventing fraud, abuse, and unauthorized transactions; and
  • Complying with applicable accounting, tax, and consumer protection laws.

We do not use your purchase details to send unsolicited commercial marketing or spam, and we do not sell your personal data to data brokers or advertising networks.

4. Third-party service providers and data sharing

To deliver our services, we share necessary data with trusted third-party providers bound by confidentiality and security obligations:

  • PayU Payments Private Limited: Regulated payment gateway partner that processes online payments and handles refunds. Necessary transaction details (order ID, customer name, email, phone number, payable amount) are passed securely to the payment provider shown at checkout.
  • Server-side order storage: Order records are processed and stored in protected server-side database systems when checkout is available; a customer account is not required.
  • Website Infrastructure Providers: Hosting, secure delivery infrastructure and server-side operations necessary to run this store.
  • Logistics Partners: Assigned national courier partners who receive your name, delivery address, postal code, and contact phone number solely to complete doorstep delivery.

5. Data security and retention

We implement robust technical and organizational measures to safeguard your personal data, including HTTPS encryption, server-side payment hash verification, and restricted server-side storage access. Order and transaction records are retained for the duration required by applicable taxation, accounting, and legal requirements, after which they are securely deleted or anonymized.

6. Your data rights

Under applicable Indian law, you have the right to:

  • Access and review the personal information we hold about you;
  • Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete contact and delivery details;
  • Request deletion of personal data, subject to mandatory legal record-keeping obligations;
  • Clear browser local storage (shopping bag, wishlist, saved delivery details, and order references) at any time through your browser settings.

To exercise any of these rights, email your request to support@attiremart.shop.

7. Grievance Officer and contact details

If you have questions, concerns, or complaints regarding our data privacy practices, contact:

Manish Kumar Sonkar, Grievance Officer
ATTIRE MART, S-10/290 A-1, Panchkosi Road, Purani Chungi, Shivpur, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, 221003, India.

title: Return, Refund & Cancellation Policy
body:
Last updated: 13 November 2026

100% TRANSPARENT POLICY: Free shipping on all orders. The refundable COD advance is ₹199 below ₹700 or ₹299 for ₹700 or above. 24-hour cancellation window with full refund. 7-day hassle-free returns after delivery. The COD confirmation advance is credited toward your order total and is fully refundable if an order is cancelled or cannot be fulfilled.

1. Order cancellation (Within 24 hours)

You may cancel any order within 24 hours of placing it without any cancellation fee or penalty. To cancel, send an email to support@attiremart.shop with your order reference (e.g. AM...) and a brief cancellation request.

Refund treatment for cancelled orders:

  • Prepaid Orders: 100% of the purchase amount paid online will be refunded in full to your original payment method through the original payment service provider.
  • Cash on Delivery (COD) Orders: The COD confirmation advance will be refunded in full to your original online payment method through the original payment service provider. The advance is never arbitrarily forfeited or declared non-refundable for eligible cancellations.

If ATTIRE MART cancels an order due to stock unavailability or inability to deliver within our 15-day commitment, 100% of any amount paid online (including the COD advance) is refunded immediately to your original payment source.

2. Return eligibility (Within 7 days of delivery)

We want you to love what you wear. If you are not satisfied with your purchase, you may initiate a return request within 7 calendar days from the date of doorstep delivery.

Conditions for return:

  • The item must be in its original delivered condition: unused, unworn, unwashed, unaltered, and free from perfume, makeup stains, or customer-caused damage.
  • All original brand tags, barcodes, price labels, and original protective packaging must remain attached and intact.
  • All components of multi-piece sets (e.g., kurta-pant-dupatta sets, co-ord sets) must be returned together.

3. Defective, damaged or incorrect products

If you receive a defective garment, an item damaged during shipping, or a product materially different from what you ordered, please notify us within 7 calendar days of delivery at support@attiremart.shop with your order number and clear photos of the defect.

For verified damaged, defective, or incorrect deliveries, ATTIRE MART will arrange a free replacement or issue a 100% refund. You will not incur any return shipping fee or deduction. An unboxing video is not mandatory to submit a complaint, though photos or videos are helpful in accelerating claim assessment.

4. Step-by-step return process

  1. Initiate Request: Email support@attiremart.shop within 7 calendar days of delivery. Include your order ID, product name, reason for return, and preferred resolution (refund or size exchange).
  2. Return Authorization: Our support team will respond within 24–48 hours with a Return Authorization and the designated warehouse address. (Please note: Our published administrative correspondence address in Varanasi is not the return warehouse. Do not ship returns there without written authorization.)
  3. Reverse Pickup or Courier: Where reverse pickup service is available through our carrier partners, a pickup will be scheduled. Alternatively, support will guide you on secure dispatch. Keep your return shipment receipt or tracking number.
  4. Warehouse Inspection: Upon receipt at our warehouse, our quality assurance team inspects the returned garment within 2–3 business days to verify its unused condition and attached tags.
  5. Refund Issuance: Once approved, the refund is initiated immediately.

5. Refund processing and timelines

  • Prepaid Purchases: Refunds are credited directly back to the original payment source (UPI, Credit/Debit Card, or NetBanking) through the payment provider shown at checkout. Once initiated by us, the banking network typically reflects the credit within 5–7 business days.
  • Cash on Delivery (COD) Orders:
    • The online COD confirmation advance is refunded back to the original online payment route used through the original payment service provider.
    • The balance paid in cash at delivery will be refunded via secure direct bank transfer (NEFT/IMPS) or verified UPI ID as confirmed directly and securely with you by customer support.
  • No Hidden Deductions: Shipping is always free (₹0); no outward shipping charge is deducted from eligible refunds.
  • Security Warning: ATTIRE MART will never ask for your card PIN, CVV, OTP, or UPI password to process a refund. Never share sensitive banking credentials with anyone.

6. Size exchanges

If you need a different size of the same style, you may request an optional size exchange within the same 7-day window, subject to stock availability in our warehouse. If the desired size is out of stock, we will process a full refund instead.

7. Support and grievance redressal

For all cancellation, return, and refund requests, contact our dedicated support channels:

Customer Support: support@attiremart.shop (Target response: 24–48 hours; resolution: 3–5 calendar days)
Grievance Officer: Manish Kumar Sonkar — grievance@attiremart.shop (Acknowledgment within 48 hours; resolution within 1 month)
Urgent Fraud Inquiries: help.fraud@attiremart.shop
Business Address: S-10/290 A-1, Panchkosi Road, Purani Chungi, Shivpur, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, 221003, India.

title: Support, Grievances & Fraud Reporting

Last updated: 13 November 2026

In accordance with the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, and the Information Technology Act, 2000, ATTIRE MART provides dedicated channels for customer support, formal grievance redressal, and urgent financial fraud reporting.

1. Routine customer support

For product inquiries, sizing guidance, order status, address changes, cancellations, and return or refund assistance, contact our customer support team:

Response Target: 24–48 hours
Resolution Target: 3–5 calendar days

2. Formal grievance officer redressal

If your inquiry is not resolved within 5 calendar days by routine support, or if you wish to file a formal complaint regarding deficient service, misleading practice, or policy violation, you may escalate directly to our designated Grievance Officer:

Grievance Officer: Manish Kumar Sonkar
Designation: Proprietor & Grievance Redressal Officer
Email: grievance@attiremart.shop
Postal Address: S-10/290 A-1, Panchkosi Road, Purani Chungi, Shivpur, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, 221003, India.

Statutory Redressal Standards:

  • Every grievance will be acknowledged within 48 hours of receipt with a formal complaint reference.
  • All grievances will be investigated and redressed within one month (30 calendar days) from the date of receipt.
  • You do not need to exhaust customer support before approaching the Grievance Officer.

3. Urgent fraud and unauthorized transaction reporting

If you suspect unauthorized transactions, fraudulent payment requests, or impersonation of ATTIRE MART, report it immediately to our dedicated fraud monitoring channel:

Fraud Escalation Email: help.fraud@attiremart.shop

Security Advisory: Please also immediately contact your issuing bank or UPI payment provider to block the compromised card or account. ATTIRE MART staff will NEVER ask you for your account password, card CVV, OTP, or UPI PIN.

4. Summary of business rules

  • Shipping: FREE shipping (₹0) on all orders.
  • COD Orders: COD advance ₹199 below ₹700 or ₹299 from ₹700 (capped at order value), credited to the order total.
  • Delivery Commitment: Maximum 15 calendar days from date of purchase.
  • Cancellations: Within 24 hours of purchase with 100% refund of any amount paid online.
  • Returns: Within 7 calendar days of delivery for unused items with original tags.
